verdict.rationale: Rootly ships its own built-in AI assistant. In Slack it takes actions on the user's behalf, such as updating severity, paging teams, and converting incidents to private, and it confirms destructive actions first. The changelog adds creating overrides and retrospectives, and AI SRE autonomously investigates alerts and incidents. The web chat is documented as read-only, so delegation of actions is centered on Slack and AI SRE. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of task delegation, and action-taking in the web app chat (documented as read-only).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Rootly AI in Slack answers questions grounded in your Rootly data and takes actions on your behalf, confirming destructive actions before they fire.
"This is now a SEV1. Update the incident severity." ... "Page the security team, and convert this to a private incident."
Rootly AI can now create overrides, look up who's on call, create retrospectives, and answer questions about Rootly.
Rootly AI SRE investigates active alerts and incidents, tests likely causes against live evidence, and gives responders a reviewable diagnosis with recommended next steps.
